reviews.text: Don't go there! Not only is the smell terrible, but the cats in the cat cafe on the second floor are all skin and bones; you can feel their bones. Some even have red eye discharge. They don't trim their paw fur, and several of the long-haired cats have messy fur. The air conditioning on the second floor is also extremely cold, and the cats' ears are freezing. It's outrageous; all they care about is making money. Don't go there!

My Maine Coon cat passed away before it even reached one year old.

When I returned to the store because the discount hadn't been applied, it seemed like the staff didn't even understand the cash register manual, so I was made to wait, and there was no apology whatsoever, giving the impression that it was my fault. There were two female staff members, but their attitude was really the worst.
If you're working with lives, I think you should have a bit more responsibility.

This cat cafe is a relaxing space where you can interact with adorable cats that feel like family. You can spend a leisurely time in a quiet environment. You can enjoy it at a great price with the Premium 40 plan for 1980 yen per month, making it recommended for frequent visitors. The staff are attentive and the cats are healthy and comfortable. It's perfect for those seeking a relaxing time.
They were very helpful and gave me thoughtful advice when I was buying a puppy.

I visited the store looking for pet supplies, and was very pleased with not only the products but also the friendly staff. The product explanations were thorough, so I was able to make a purchase with confidence. The store itself is clean and comfortable, and I'd like to return.

I found this store to be very affordable. You can easily choose what you need without worrying too much about the price. Because the prices are low, you can also find many items for your family. The Premium 40 option is easy to use and especially convenient for regular visitors. The store's atmosphere is simple and makes shopping easy.

I purchased items at the store. Not only were the prices low, but the staff were polite and helpful, making for a pleasant shopping experience. The store was clean, creating a safe and comfortable environment. I would like to use this store again.
They also sell snacks and toys, which is nice.
There are so many different kinds of sweets and it's very useful!

I recently visited this grooming salon for the first time, and I was very reassured by the staff's polite and attentive service. I appreciate how gently they treated my beloved dog, who is like family to me. Using their subscription service is convenient and cost-effective.

This pet shop has two floors, with a cat cafe on the second floor. If you want to use the cat cafe, you check in on the first floor and then go up to the second floor. There are no staff on the second floor, so you have the place to yourself. The cats are friendly and you can spend your time there relaxing. You can buy treats on the first floor. As other reviews have said, the cats' claws may be a little sharp. Is it cute that they will dig their claws into your knees or hands when you call them with treats?

I've been to this cat cafe several times, but I get the impression that they don't really take good care of the cats' health.
There are cats with blood in their urine, cats that sneeze frequently and have a lot of eye discharge (maybe it's a cat flu?), and cats with overgrown claws.

The hygiene management seems inconsistent among the staff, as the cages for the cats sold on the first floor are sometimes clean and sometimes dirty.
Once, the entire glass display case was dirty (probably because it hadn't been wiped, and the water was cloudy), the litter box wasn't being used, and there was a small cockroach in the kitten display case.
It was clean the last time I went! ^^

Overall, I wish they would pay a little more attention to the condition of the dogs and cats. I hope to be able to visit again.

There are some very cute puppies and kittens!
